title: You breathe 20,000 times a day 🫁 #shorts
description:
At rest, adults take about 12–20 breaths a minute — around 20,000 breaths a day. Each calm breath moves about half a liter of air, so you move over 10,000 liters of air daily, into roughly 480 million tiny air sacs.
Math: 15/min × 1,440 min = 21,600 breaths; × 0.5 L ≈ 10,800 L.
Sources: Cleveland Clinic (vital signs, 12–20 breaths/min); Ochs et al. 2004, Am J Respir Crit Care Med (mean 480 million alveoli).

Inner Numbers — your body, counted. New Short every day.
Educational content, not medical advice.

scenes.say: You'll breathe about twenty thousand times today.
At rest, an adult takes twelve to twenty breaths every minute.
Each calm breath moves about half a liter of air.
That's more than ten thousand liters of air, every single day.
It ends in around four hundred and eighty million tiny air sacs.
All without you thinking about it. Follow for more of your body, counted.
